newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India GDRs little changed, Taiwan up.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India GDRs little changed, Taiwan up.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts were hardly changed in moderate Wednesday trade as the market attracted limited interest ahead of a Bombay holiday on Thursday.
Traders and brokers said the GDR market was unlikely to show much change on Thursday due to the holiday, and prices were seen trading in relatively tight bands in the near term.
An anticipated increase in petroleum product prices and a corruption scandal involving Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's Janata Dal party chief kept buyers on the sidelines in Bombay earlier.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed 0.07 points down at 77.67, with the premium over the local market at 18.94 percent from 18.49 percent.
Reliance shed 22 cents to $18.90/19.40, and SBI was seven cents softer at $23.25/$24.25.
Taiwanese GDRs rose again following a strong run in the local market on the back of a cabinet reshuffle.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index added 4.14 points, or 3.42 percent, to 125.19, representing a discount to the local market of 2.13 percent.
The Capel Korea GDR Index lost 0.90 points to 60.67 points, a premium of 30.60 percent over the local market.
